findings.finding: The 'second gap' region fix (#2/#3) does not reconcile its necessity claim with the plan's own root-cause evidence: rebar.toml:206 already sets `bedrock_region_name = "us-east-1"`, which is arm-1 (highest precedence) of resolve_bedrock_region — evaluated BEFORE AWS_DEFAULT_REGION/AWS_REGION. The claim 'the fix fails differently without it' is therefore not established for THIS surface (unlike the review-bot's measured a574 container, which apparently lacked config-resolved region).

If instead the deployed checkout at /var/gerrit/site/mcp-code does NOT carry (or does not discover) rebar.toml, then the model string would ALSO fail to resolve — contradicting the plan's root-cause framing that only the provider package is missing.
